messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Integer-grid lattice search with post-hoc continuous relaxation

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "A 13-point integer-grid configuration on [0,12]×[0,12] with minimum triangle area 6 (rescaled to 1/24 ≈ 0.04167 in the unit square) is optimal among all grid-restricted placements, and continuous relaxation of the optimal lattice solution improves the minimum triangle area by less than 5%, yielding a final configuration with all triangle areas exceeding 0.043. The optimal grid configuration consists of a structured asymmetric arrangement with determinant-6 minimum-area triangles, and local perturbation of point positions cannot enlarge all such triangles simultaneously due to shared-edge constraints that propagate conflicts across the configuration."}
